requirement: ATC, Pilot and Ground agents negotiate a resolution to a real-time disruption without human intervention until consensus is reached
how_met: Three independent agents; a plan is adopted only when every agent accepts it; humans receive a briefing to sign off

requirement: ATC agent: runway wake separation, taxiway blockage, maximise sector throughput
how_met: Hard checks WAKE_SEPARATION, TAXIWAY_BLOCKED and RUNWAY_CAPACITY; ATC votes on holding and on how long the arrival bank takes
where_to_see: Replays: wake fault; Live: block a taxiway

requirement: Pilot agent: preserve fuel reserves, ensure flight safety, minimise turbulence, protect passenger connections
how_met: Hard checks FUEL_RESERVE, SEVERE_TURBULENCE and CREW_DUTY; the pilot picks the arrival route, trading time, fuel and turbulence; connections drive its votes

requirement: Ground agent: optimise gate utilisation, avoid ground-crew overtime, minimise turnaround delays
how_met: Planned gate plus spare gates, GATE_CHANGE_NOTICE check, 8-hour shifts with overtime costed at 1.5x, next-leg delay in its votes
where_to_see: Evaluation: crew overtime and next-leg delay

how_met: Every message is a Pydantic schema; Claude replies through structured outputs and invalid output counts as an agent failure
where_to_see: Live: the record under each chat bubble and the Structured messages (JSON) panel

how_met: Deterministic checker (pure Python) on every candidate plan and again before the decision is committed
where_to_see: Live and Replays: red 'Safety checker' notices

how_met: Append-only log, each entry SHA-256 chained to the previous one; editing any entry breaks the chain
where_to_see: Replays: hash-chain badge and the tamper switch

how_met: Greedy allocator using the same cost function; decides on no agreement after the turn limit, or on any agent error, timeout or invalid output

requirement: Negotiate a revised arrival time, gate assignment or flight-plan adjustment in under 3 turns
how_met: Each decision sets landing time, runway, arrival route, gate and crew; hard limit of three turns

requirement: Use a row with WEATHER_DELAY > 15 or LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY > 20 and pass its parameters to the three agents
how_met: Live picks one of the 1,290 rows of flights.csv that meet the rule; its delays, times and airports become the agents' situation

requirement: Combining the three roles in a single prompt call
how_met: One Claude call per agent, each with its own system prompt and a private view of only its own domain
where_to_see: Overview: how it works; Live: one typing indicator per agent

requirement: Agents talking in endless, unconstrained loops
how_met: At most three turns, then the deterministic fallback; checker, arbiter and mediator are code, not extra turns

requirement: Accepting solutions that ignore safety margins
